Got a last minute appt at the DMV and downloaded this app a few days before my test. I’ve been driving for 20+ yrs in the UK and over a year in the US but hadn’t got round to getting a NC licence. None of the questions on this app were on the test. There were some that were similar. But quite a few of them were about laws involving alcohol or losing your licence. Example: How long do you lose your licence for if you buy alcohol for minors. Not sure how relevant that was to being able to drive but…..so while the app helped a lot with learning things to do with the road, you really also need to be looking up local laws. I got four questions wrong pretty early on. Managed to get the rest right, and definitely had to guess two of them because I had no clue. So don’t just rely on this app to get a definite pass.
